context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter about a community crisis
purpose: Teach: 閉鎖/破綻/放棄/収容/虐待/誘導/消滅/陥っ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お疲れ様です。今回の事件についてですが、児童養護施設での虐待が発覚しまして、地域全体が混乱に陥っています。
lines.en: Good work coming. Regarding this case, child abuse was uncovered at a children's care facility, and the whole community has fallen into chaos.
lines.style: Formal, measured, professional briefing tone with controlled gravity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんな酷いことが…。その施設はもう閉鎖されたんですか?
lines.en: Something that terrible... Has the facility already been shut down?
lines.style: Young, earnest, slightly shaken but determined to report.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい、昨日付けで運営法人が経営破綻し、職員も責任を放棄して逃げた状態です。子どもたちは一時的に別の施設へ収容しました。
lines.en: Yes, as of yesterday the operating organization went bankrupt, and the staff abandoned their responsibilities and fled. The children have been temporarily housed in another facility.
lines.style: Crisp, official, matter-of-fact recital of grim facts.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 子どもたちは無事なんでしょうか?搬送の時はどう対応されたんですか?
lines.en: Are the children safe? How did you handle things during the transport?
lines.style: Eager, journalistic, concern breaking through professionalism.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察官が現場で避難誘導を行い、一人ずつ安全に運び出しました。今は心のケアが最優先です。
lines.en: Officers conducted evacuation guidance on-site and carried each child out safely. Right now, mental care is the top priority.
lines.style: Reassuring but firm, emphasizing duty and care.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この施設の存在自体が消滅してしまうということですか?今後の見通しを教えてください。
lines.en: Does that mean the facility's very existence will disappear? Please tell me the outlook going forward.
lines.style: Probing, polite but pressing for substantive information.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 法人としては解散ですが、地域で新たな受け皿を作る動きがあります。記事では支援を呼びかけてもらえると助かります。
lines.en: The organization will dissolve, but there's movement to create a new safety net in the community. It would help if your article called for support.
lines.style: Cooperative, hopeful undertone, inviting media partnership.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 必ず書きます。読者にしっかり伝わる記事にしますので、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: I'll definitely write it. I'll make sure the article reaches readers properly, so thank you in advance.
lines.style: Resolute, respectful, closing with youthful determination.
